in_sanskrit.name: बहुश्रुत
in_sanskrit.meaning: बहुस (bahus) = many, श्रुत (shruta) = knowledge, expert, learned, wise
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Having great knowledge, expert, learned, wise.

in_hindi.name: बहुश्रुत
in_hindi.meaning: बहुस (bahus) = many, श्रुत (shruta) = जानना (janana) = to know, विजानता (vijanata) = expert, learned, wise
in_hindi.long_meaning: बहुस (many) + श्रुत (to know) = जानना (to know) + विजानता (expert, learned, wise)

in_marathi.name: Bahushruta
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bahushruta हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bahus means 'many' and Shruta means 'heard', thus Bahushruta means 'he who has heard much' or 'learned'.

in_bengali.name: Bahushruta
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Learned, Scholar
in_bengali.long_meaning: Bahushruta একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Bahus means 'many' and Shruta means 'heard', thus Bahushruta means 'he who has heard much' or 'learned'.
